_comment: Token lint rules for Modules/Nameplates (plan 6.3, Decision 3 and 6). Paths are relative to the SpartanUI folder and use fnmatch (* also crosses folders). Suppress one finding with a same-line or previous-line comment: -- np-lint: allow <rule-id> <reason>. Rules marked suppressible false cannot be suppressed.

rules.message: Only Host/SpartanUI.lua may name SUI; take what you need from the host table
Only Host/SpartanUI.lua may name SpartanUI (paths, strings, assets, commands)
Addon file paths come from host.mediaPath, never a fixed Interface\AddOns path
Host-specific global used in the core
Never print(); write to the logger the host hands in
WoW runs Lua 5.1: no goto or continue; use flags and nested conditions
WoW runs Lua 5.1: no labels, integer division or bitwise operators (use bit.band and friends)
Only Engine/Source.lua may read units; go through the Source object

A *Secret value may only go straight into an approved sink (Secret.SINKS in Core/Secret.lua, a game API documented AllowedWhenTainted, a Core/Secret.lua helper, a function whose name ends in Secret, or the sinks list) or a local whose name ends in Secret. SetAlpha is not a sink until an in-game check confirms it
rules._sinksComment: Sinks come from Secret.SINKS in Core/Secret.lua (the authority), the functions that file defines, game APIs documented AllowedWhenTainted in the data files, and the names below (Lua built-ins and helpers that are not game widget methods). notSinks are documented sinks the plan keeps off until an in-game check.

rules.message: Never key a table by auraInstanceID (it can be secret)
No fixed global names in the core; build names from the host prefix or pass nil
Named XML objects and templates are global; the core may not fix their names
